market.for_visitors: Prices are in Japanese yen, tax included. Most Rakuten Ichiba shops ship only within Japan: from abroad, look for a shop that ships internationally or use a forwarding service. Manufacturer warranties on products bought in Japan are often valid only in Japan.

how_to_choose.summary: Compare by price per kg. Taste and price vary with the brand, the crop year and whether it is single-origin or blended. To skip rinsing and save water, choose musenmai (no-rinse rice), which tends to cost a little more for the same weight.

criteria.name: Price per kg
criteria.detail: Sizes vary (5 kg, 10 kg, 2 × 5 kg and so on), so compare the price divided by the total weight. For listings with shipping extra, recalculate with shipping included.

criteria.name: Crop year and milling date
criteria.detail: The newer the “Reiwa N” crop year, the closer to new-crop rice. Flavour fades after milling, so buying small amounts with a recent milling date tastes better.

criteria.name: Single-origin or blended
criteria.detail: “Single-origin rice” (tan’itsu genryōmai) contains only rice of the same region, variety and crop year. Blended rice is cheaper and usually tastes less good than brand rice.

criteria.name: Musenmai
criteria.detail: Can be cooked without rinsing, so there is no rinse water and you save time and water. Because part of the grain is removed in milling, it tends to cost a little more for the same weight.

criteria.name: Storage
criteria.detail: Keep it away from heat and humidity in an airtight container. In summer, the vegetable drawer of the fridge suits it. As a guide, buy an amount you can finish in about a month.

pitfalls: “5 kg × 2” and “10 kg” are the same amount. Separate bags are easier to store.
Subscriptions and furusato nozei gifts are a different comparison (only ordinary purchases are compared here).
how_to_choose.abroad: Many countries restrict bringing in rice; check your country’s import rules before taking it home.

method.summary: For each category, up to 60 Rakuten listings are fetched in order of review count and filtered by excluded words, price range and a minimum number of reviews. Listings of the same product by different shops (same model number, or the same specs and a near-identical title) are merged into the best-rated one, with the other shops’ prices kept in other_offers. The rest are ranked by a Bayesian average rating.
method.formula: score = (C × m + n × r) / (C + n)  … r = the product’s average rating, n = number of reviews, m = average rating of all candidates, C = 50
method.why: So that a 4.4★ with thousands of reviews ranks above a 5★ with a handful. The fewer the reviews, the more a rating is pulled towards the average.

picks.budget: Cheapest among products in the top 40% by score
picks.deal: Among products priced below usual, the one furthest below its median (outliers and pick-a-variant listings excluded)

method.priceVerdict: Prices are recorded daily and compared only with days on the same shipping terms. Under 7 days observed: insufficient_data. At the lowest observed price and at least 3% under the median: lowest_observed. At or under 90% of the median: below_usual. At or over 110%: above_usual. Otherwise usual. The window is up to 90 days and reported as window_days.
method.caveat: Specs are extracted mechanically from product titles and may be wrong. Check the product page before buying.

unit_rule.label: per kg
unit_rule.note: Calculated from the size and count in each listing title. Pick-a-variant listings and unclear titles are left out. Listings with shipping extra may rank differently once shipping is added.
